Development notes, MeSH checks, and query tests are in [search_build_report.md](/C:/Users/aaron/AppData/Local/Temp/psb-evals/run-1ea9c6b0d2472c4a/lean-optimal-codex-noseed-20260927T145608Z/work/search_build_report.md).

The final search combines SEM and latent-variable model terms with Bayesian estimation terms. It leaves small-sample context, simulation, comparison, and publication type to screening to reduce the risk of missing eligible studies.

The present-day PubMed index returned 1,094 matches for the date-limited query. That count is not a frozen 2017 result set: current PubMed records can carry multiple publication dates. No seed PMIDs were available. This PubMed-only draft still needs review by a second information specialist under PRESS before use as the final search.
